basic.name: 普通攻击：利齿修剪法
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的攻击，造成物理伤害；
第三段攻击期间，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以延长招式的持续时间。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks, dealing Physical DMG.
Press repeatedly or hold [Basic Attack] during the 3rd attack to extend the skill duration.

special.name: 特殊技：摆尾
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行快速甩尾攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Use a quick tail sweep attack in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：横扫
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力甩尾攻击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
命中敌人时，获得1点[急冻充能]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a forceful tail whip attack that deals massive Ice DMG.
Gain 1 Flash Freeze Charge upon striking an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

dodge.name: 闪避：涡漩
dodge.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
触发[极限闪避]时，艾莲将获得[快蓄]效果，缩短[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]的蓄力时间，最多持续5秒或触发一次。
dodge.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A rapid dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When Perfect Dodge is triggered, Ellen gains the Quick Charge effect, reducing the charge time of Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, lasting up to 5 seconds or until it triggers.

dashAttack.name: 冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭
dashAttack.trigger: 在[巡游]状态下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dashAttack.triggerEn: While in the Roaming state, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
dashAttack.description:
在[巡游]状态下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对敌人进行回旋斩击，随后拉开剪刀，发动快速剪击，造成冰属性伤害；
快速剪击命中时，获得1点[急冻充能]。

在[巡游]状态下，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对敌人进行回旋斩击，随后拉开剪刀，发动蓄力剪击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
蓄力剪击命中时，获得3点[急冻充能]，若敌人处于[冻结]状态下，则必定触发[碎冰]效果；
招式蓄力期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
招式蓄力期间受到敌人伤害时，可以免疫该次伤害，并立即完成蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dashAttack.descriptionEn:
While in the Roaming state, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Delivers a spinning slash to enemies before opening her scissors for a Swift Scissors strike, dealing Ice DMG.
Gain 1 point of Flash Freeze Charge when the Swift Scissors strike hits.

While in the Roaming state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform a spinning slash against the enemy, then pull apart the scissors to unleash a Charged Scissor strike, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Gain 3 points of Flash Freeze Charge when the Charged Scissor strike hits. If the enemy is Frozen, it always triggers Shatter.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while charging the skill, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
When taking DMG from enemies while the skill is charging, that instance of DMG is nullified, and charging instantly completes.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：暗礁
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
快速穿过敌人，拉开剪刀进行剪击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Rapidly move through enemies with open scissors for a cutting strike, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：雪崩
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
从空中下砸并生成一阵冰风暴，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Crash down from above and unleash an ice storm, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：永冬狂宴
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
从空中下砸并生成一阵冰风暴，随后使用剪刀进行强力一击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Crash down from above and unleash an ice storm before a powerful scissor strike, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：护卫鲛
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
快速穿过敌人，拉开剪刀进行剪击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，拖曳摇杆，点按 【切换键】 发动：
进入[巡游]状态，快速冲刺移动；
在[巡游]状态下使用摇杆控制方向，松开摇杆则会停下；
招式发动瞬间拥有短暂的无敌效果。
发动[快速支援]时，艾莲将获得[快蓄]效果，缩短[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]的蓄力时间，最多持续5秒或触发一次。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Speedily move through the enemy with open scissors for a cutting strike, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the character on the field is launched, drag the joystick and press [Switch] to activate:
Enter the Roaming state, enabling dashing movement.
While in the Roaming state, use the joystick to change directions and release to stop.
Character is invulnerable briefly when triggering the skill.
Upon triggering a Quick Assist, Ellen gains the Quick Charge effect, shortening the charging time of Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, lasting up to 5s or until it triggers once.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：迎头浪
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：巡洋鲨
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动突进斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式攻击期间，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以延长招式的持续时间；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charge and slash enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Press repeatedly or hold [Basic Attack] during the attack to extend the skill duration.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.text:
艾莲在[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]中发动蓄力剪击，或消耗[急冻充能]发动[普通攻击：急冻修剪法]时，招式的暴击伤害提升100%；
上述效果对[连携技]、[终结技]、[普通攻击：霜锋]和[普通攻击：冰刃浪]同样生效。
fields.textEn:
When Ellen launches a Charged Scissor strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, or consumes Flash Freeze Charge to activate Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming, the skill's CRIT DMG increases by 100%.
The above effect also applies to Chain Attacks, Ultimates, Basic Attack: Icy Blade, and Basic Attack: Glacial Blade Wave.

fields.text:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色或[击破]角色时触发：
艾莲造成冰属性伤害时，后继冰属性伤害提升3%，持续10秒，最多叠加10层，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
fields.textEn:
When another character in your squad is a Stun character or shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Ellen deals Ice DMG, subsequent Ice DMG increases by 3% for 10s. This effect can stack up to 10 times, and repeated triggers reset the duration.

basic.name: 普通攻击：利齿修剪法
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的攻击，造成物理伤害；

Press repeatedly or hold [Basic Attack] during the 3rd attack to extend the skill duration.

basic.name: 普通攻击：急冻修剪法
basic.description:
激活[急冻]效果后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
每段攻击消耗1点[急冻充能]；
第三段攻击期间，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以延长招式的持续时间。
basic.descriptionEn:
While Flash Freeze is active, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to 3 attacks at enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Each attack consumes 1 Flash Freeze Charge.
Press repeatedly or hold [Basic Attack] during the 3rd attack to extend the skill duration.

basic.name: 普通攻击：冰刃浪（潜能觉醒）
basic.nameEn: Basic Attack: Glacial Blade Wave (Potential Awakening)
basic.description:
第三段[普通攻击：急冻修剪法]、[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]蓄力剪击、[闪避反击：暗礁]和[快速支援]发动后，若艾莲拥有[急冻充能]，点按 【普通攻击键】 可以发动[普通攻击：冰刃浪]，造成冰属性伤害；
招式消耗2点[急冻充能];
招式发动后，可直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
basic.descriptionEn:
After the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming, Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush's charged scissor strike, Dodge Counter: Reef Rock, and Quick Assist, if Ellen has Flash Freeze Charges, pressing [Basic Attack] will launch Basic Attack: Glacial Blade Wave, dealing Ice DMG.
This skill consumes 2 points of Flash Freeze Charge.
After use, it can be directly followed up with the 3rd hit of her Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

basic.name: 普通攻击：霜锋（潜能觉醒）
basic.description:
第三段[普通攻击：急冻修剪法]、[强化特殊技：鲨卷风]、[闪避反击：暗礁]和[支援突击]发动后，将自动发动[普通攻击：霜锋]，对前方大范围敌人造成多段冰属性伤害，且对中/大体型的敌人会分别额外造成多段冰属性伤害；
招式发动后，艾莲将获得[快蓄]效果；
[普通攻击：霜锋]不影响原本招式派生;
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
basic.descriptionEn:
After the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming, EX Special Attack: Sharknami, Dodge Counter: Reef Rock, and Assist Follow-Up, automatically launch Basic Attack: Icy Blade, dealing multiple instances of Ice DMG to all enemies in a large area ahead. It inflicts additional instances of Ice DMG against Medium and Large foes.
After the skill, Ellen gains the Quick Charge effect.
Basic Attack: Icy Blade does not affect the branch or form of the original skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Perform a forceful tail whip attack that deals massive Ice DMG.
Gain 1 Flash Freeze Charge upon striking an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：鲨卷风

[强化特殊技：横扫]发动后，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力连续斩击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
命中敌人时，获得1点[急冻充能]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]。

With enough Energy and after executing EX Special Attack: Tail Swipe, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a powerful series of slashes ahead that deal massive Ice DMG.
Gain 1 Flash Freeze Charge upon striking an enemy.

ultimate.name: 终结技：永冬狂宴
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
从空中下砸并生成一阵冰风暴，随后使用剪刀进行强力一击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Crash down from above and unleash an ice storm before a powerful scissor strike, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：护卫鲛
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
快速穿过敌人，拉开剪刀进行剪击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，拖曳摇杆，点按 【切换键】 发动：
进入[巡游]状态，快速冲刺移动；
在[巡游]状态下使用摇杆控制方向，松开摇杆则会停下；
招式发动瞬间拥有短暂的无敌效果。
发动[快速支援]时，艾莲将获得[快蓄]效果，缩短[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]的蓄力时间，最多持续5秒或触发一次。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Speedily move through the enemy with open scissors for a cutting strike, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the character on the field is launched, drag the joystick and press [Switch] to activate:
Enter the Roaming state, enabling dashing movement.
While in the Roaming state, use the joystick to change directions and release to stop.
Character is invulnerable briefly when triggering the skill.
Upon triggering a Quick Assist, Ellen gains the Quick Charge effect, shortening the charging time of Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, lasting up to 5s or until it triggers once.

fields.name: 普通攻击：利齿修剪法

fields.description:

第三段攻击期间，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以延长招式的持续时间。
fields.descriptionEn:

Unleashes up to 3 attacks, dealing Physical DMG.
Press repeatedly or hold [Basic Attack] during the 3rd attack to extend the skill duration.

fields.name: 普通攻击：急冻修剪法

fields.triggerEn: While Flash Freeze is active, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
fields.description:
激活[急冻]效果后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：

fields.triggerEn: After the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming, Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush's charged scissor strike, Dodge Counter: Reef Rock, and Quick Assist, if Ellen has Flash Freeze Charges, pressing [Basic Attack] will launch Basic Attack: Glacial Blade Wave, dealing Ice DMG.
fields.description:
第三段[普通攻击：急冻修剪法]、[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]蓄力剪击、[闪避反击：暗礁]和[快速支援]发动后，若艾莲拥有[急冻充能]，点按 【普通攻击键】 可以发动[普通攻击：冰刃浪]，造成冰属性伤害；

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 普通攻击：霜锋（潜能觉醒）

fields.triggerEn: After the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming, EX Special Attack: Sharknami, Dodge Counter: Reef Rock, and Assist Follow-Up, automatically launch Basic Attack: Icy Blade, dealing multiple instances of Ice DMG to all enemies in a large area ahead. It inflicts additional instances of Ice DMG against Medium and Large foes.
fields.description:

[普通攻击：霜锋]不影响原本招式派生;
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。

Ellen is invulnerable for a brief time after activation.

fields.trigger: 在[巡游]状态下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：

在[巡游]状态下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：

快速剪击命中时，获得1点[急冻充能]。

在[巡游]状态下，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对敌人进行回旋斩击，随后拉开剪刀，发动蓄力剪击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
蓄力剪击命中时，获得3点[急冻充能]，若敌人处于[冻结]状态下，则必定触发[碎冰]效果；
招式蓄力期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
招式蓄力期间受到敌人伤害时，可以免疫该次伤害，并立即完成蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
While in the Roaming state, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Delivers a spinning slash to enemies before opening her scissors for a Swift Scissors strike, dealing Ice DMG.
Gain 1 point of Flash Freeze Charge when the Swift Scissors strike hits.

While in the Roaming state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform a spinning slash against the enemy, then pull apart the scissors to unleash a Charged Scissor strike, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Gain 3 points of Flash Freeze Charge when the Charged Scissor strike hits. If the enemy is Frozen, it always triggers Shatter.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while charging the skill, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
When taking DMG from enemies while the skill is charging, that instance of DMG is nullified, and charging instantly completes.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 急冻

fields.description:
艾莲在[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]中发动蓄力剪击，或消耗[急冻充能]发动[普通攻击：急冻修剪法]时，招式的暴击伤害提升100%；
上述效果对[连携技]、[终结技]、[普通攻击：霜锋]和[普通攻击：冰刃浪]同样生效。
fields.descriptionEn:
When Ellen launches a Charged Scissor strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, or consumes Flash Freeze Charge to activate Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming, the skill's CRIT DMG increases by 100%.
The above effect also applies to Chain Attacks, Ultimates, Basic Attack: Icy Blade, and Basic Attack: Glacial Blade Wave.

fields.name: 额外能力：风暴潮
fields.trigger: 队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色或[击破]角色时触发：
fields.triggerEn: When another character in your squad is a Stun character or shares the same Attribute or Faction:
fields.description:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色或[击破]角色时触发：
艾莲造成冰属性伤害时，后继冰属性伤害提升3%，持续10秒，最多叠加10层，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
fields.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Stun character or shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Ellen deals Ice DMG, subsequent Ice DMG increases by 3% for 10s. This effect can stack up to 10 times, and repeated triggers reset the duration.

fields.triggerEn: No separate ability text is provided for this rank; see the corresponding awakened skill variants.
fields.description: 本阶未单列额外能力文本；技能变化见对应的潜能觉醒变体。
fields.descriptionEn: No separate ability text is provided for this rank; see the corresponding awakened skill variants.

fields.name: 普通攻击：冰刃浪（潜能觉醒）
fields.nameEn: Basic Attack: Glacial Blade Wave (Potential Awakening)
fields.description:
第三段[普通攻击：急冻修剪法]、[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]蓄力剪击、[闪避反击：暗礁]和[快速支援]发动后，若艾莲拥有[急冻充能]，点按 【普通攻击键】 可以发动[普通攻击：冰刃浪]，造成冰属性伤害；
招式消耗2点[急冻充能];
招式发动后，可直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
After the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming, Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush's charged scissor strike, Dodge Counter: Reef Rock, and Quick Assist, if Ellen has Flash Freeze Charges, pressing [Basic Attack] will launch Basic Attack: Glacial Blade Wave, dealing Ice DMG.
This skill consumes 2 points of Flash Freeze Charge.
After use, it can be directly followed up with the 3rd hit of her Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 普通攻击：霜锋（潜能觉醒）
fields.description:
第三段[普通攻击：急冻修剪法]、[强化特殊技：鲨卷风]、[闪避反击：暗礁]和[支援突击]发动后，将自动发动[普通攻击：霜锋]，对前方大范围敌人造成多段冰属性伤害，且对中/大体型的敌人会分别额外造成多段冰属性伤害；
招式发动后，艾莲将获得[快蓄]效果；
[普通攻击：霜锋]不影响原本招式派生;
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
After the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming, EX Special Attack: Sharknami, Dodge Counter: Reef Rock, and Assist Follow-Up, automatically launch Basic Attack: Icy Blade, dealing multiple instances of Ice DMG to all enemies in a large area ahead. It inflicts additional instances of Ice DMG against Medium and Large foes.
After the skill, Ellen gains the Quick Charge effect.
Basic Attack: Icy Blade does not affect the branch or form of the original skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 冲刺：狩猎巡游
fields.description:
长按或双击 【闪避键】 发动：
进入[巡游]状态，快速冲刺移动；
在[巡游]状态下使用摇杆控制方向，松开摇杆则会停下；
招式发动瞬间拥有短暂的无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
Hold or double-press [Dodge] to activate:
Enter the Roaming state, allowing dashing movement.
In the Roaming state, drag the joystick to control Ellen's direction, and release to stop.
Ellen is invulnerable for a brief time after activation.

fields.name: 急冻
fields.description: 拥有[急冻充能]时，将激活[急冻]效果；激活[急冻]效果后，[普通攻击]和[冲刺攻击]将消耗[急冻充能]，造成大量冰属性伤害；艾莲最多可以拥有6点[急冻充能]。
fields.descriptionEn: When Ellen has Flash Freeze Charges, the Flash Freeze effect is activated. Once Flash Freeze activates, Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks expend Flash Freeze Charges, dealing massive Ice DMG. Ellen can have up to a maximum of 6 Flash Freeze Charges.
